```{r load-packages-notrun, results='hide'}
library(sf)          # analysing and managing spatial data
library(maptiles)    # downloading and plotting map tiles for map backgrounds
library(ggmap)       # plotting spatial data
library(prettymapr)  # adding annotations to maps
library(viridis)     # accessible colour palettes
library(shadowtext)  # shadowed text for greater contrast in ggplot/ggmap
```

afw25 <- read.csv("afw25all.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
